incidents.name: MonoX Monoswap self-swap price inflation
incidents.notes: Monoswap's swap path never rejected tokenIn == tokenOut and updated the tokenIn price before the tokenOut price, so repeatedly swapping MONO for MONO ratcheted MONO's recorded price up until the attacker could buy out the pools' other assets.

sources.ref: onchain review: Monoswap proxy 0xc36a7887 created 2021-10-16 by 0xab5167e8cc36a3a91fd2d75c6147140cd1837355, not by attack sender 0xecbe385f; four EIP-1967 upgrades before the incident, the last on 2021-11-25 (impl 0x66e7d783). lossUsd is the reported combined Ethereum + Polygon figure; this row anchors the Ethereum leg (Polygon tx 0x5a03b9c03eedcb9ec6e70c6841eaa4976a732d050a6218969e39483bb3004d5d) and no separate Polygon row is added
